name: Progress-18
about: Progress-18 (1983-106A), a crewed vehicle (Progress), launched 1983 Oct 20. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1983 Oct 27), held fixed
docked to S13138; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
